title: Zoning map change for 100-12 Queens Boulevard, Forest Hills
summary: This resolution approves a City Planning Commission decision to change zoning districts at 100-12 Queens Boulevard in Forest Hills, Queens. The change would allow a 21-story mixed-use building with about 389 apartments, including 97 income-restricted units, and 16,000 square feet of commercial space. It is related to a separate zoning text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area for the site.
